reproduction_sources.stackd-bridge-overlap-smoke.py:
import concurrent.futures,copy,fcntl,hashlib,json,os,socket,subprocess,sys,time,traceback,uuid
IMAGE='nicolaka/netshoot@sha256:47b907d662d139d1e2f22bfe14f4efca1e3f1feed283572f47c970c780c03b61'
phase=sys.argv[1]; binary=sys.argv[2]; prefix='stackd-overlap-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
report={'phase':phase,'owner':prefix,'observations':{},'cleanup':{}}
controllers=[]; bridges=[]; containers=[]; owners=[]; tables=[];publics=[]
def run(args,check=True):
 r=subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
 if check and r.returncode:raise RuntimeError(str(args)+': '+r.stdout+r.stderr)
 return r
def helper(script):return run(['docker','run','--rm','--network','host','--cap-drop','ALL','--cap-add','NET_ADMIN',IMAGE,'sh','-ec',script]).stdout
def controller():
 c=subprocess.Popen([binary],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True);controllers.append(c);return c
def call(c,op,**kw):
 kw.setdefault('StateDirectory','/tmp/'+prefix);c.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(Op=op,**kw))+'\n');c.stdin.flush();v=json.loads(c.stdout.readline());return v
def okay(c,op,**kw):
 v=call(c,op,**kw);assert 'error' not in v,v;return v['result']
def denied(v,phrase):assert phrase in v.get('error',''),v
allow={'CIDR':'0.0.0.0/0','Protocol':-1}
base={'NetworkID':prefix,'Pool':'10.253.241.0/24','Gateway':'10.253.241.1','Address':'10.253.241.10','MAC':'02:00:00:fd:f1:10','Policy':{'Subnet':'10.253.241.0/24','SecurityIngress':[allow],'SecurityEgress':[allow],'ACLIngress':[{'Number':100,'Allow':True,'Rule':allow}],'ACLEgress':[{'Number':100,'Allow':True,'Rule':allow}],'PublicEgress':True,'PublicIPv4':'198.19.241.71'}}
def private_spec(octet):
 s=copy.deepcopy(base);s.update(NetworkID=prefix+'-'+str(octet),Pool=f'198.19.{octet}.0/24',Gateway=f'198.19.{octet}.1',Address=f'198.19.{octet}.71');s['Policy'].update(Subnet=s['Pool'],PublicEgress=False,PublicIPv4='');return s
def bridge(c,s):
 bridges.append(s);return okay(c,'bridge',Spec=s)
def new_owner():
 n='stackd_ec2_'+uuid.uuid4().hex;owners.append(n);return n
def table(p):return 'stackd_public_'+socket.inet_aton(p).hex()
def apply(c,s,name=None):return call(c,'apply',Name=name or owner,Spec=s,Peer=peer,Bridge=b)
def reach():
 with socket.create_connection((base['Policy']['PublicIPv4'],8080),3) as s:
  s.settimeout(3);v=s.recv(64).decode();assert v=='public-owner\n',v;return v.strip()
try:
 c1=controller();c2=controller();b=bridge(c1,base)
 name=prefix+'-server';containers.append(name)
 program="import socket; s=socket.socket();s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET,socket.SO_REUSEADDR,1);s.bind(('0.0.0.0',8080));s.listen();\nwhile True:\n c,a=s.accept();c.sendall(b'public-owner\\n');c.close()"
 run(['docker','run','-d','--name',name,'--network',b['Name'],'--ip',base['Address'],'--mac-address',base['MAC'],IMAGE,'python3','-u','-c',program])
 idx=int(run(['docker','exec',name,'cat','/sys/class/net/eth0/iflink']).stdout);peer=next(x['ifname'] for x in json.loads(helper('ip -j link show master '+b['Device'])) if x['ifindex']==idx)
 owner=new_owner();publics.append(base['Policy']['PublicIPv4']);tables.append(table(publics[-1]));assert 'error' not in apply(c1,base)
 report['observations']['mapping_first_reachable_before']=reach()
 conflict=private_spec(241);bridges.append(conflict);v=call(c2,'bridge',Spec=conflict)
 if phase=='before':
  assert 'error' not in v,v
  report['observations']['mapping_first_private_second']={'incorrectly_admitted':v['result'],'private_destination_cross_scope_dnat':reach()}
 else:
  denied(v,'overlaps native public IPv4');report['observations']['mapping_first_private_second']=v
  report['observations']['original_mapping_survives']=reach()
  # Existing bridge inspect also releases flock before the attachment callback applies policy.
  v=call(c2,'bridge',Spec=base,Name=owner,Peer=peer,CallbackApply=True);assert 'error' not in v,v
  report['observations']['callback_policy_reentry']=reach()
  # Benchmark pool without a public collision is admissible; reverse-order install rejects.
  benchmark=private_spec(242);bb=bridge(c2,benchmark);probe=copy.deepcopy(base);probe['Policy']['PublicIPv4']='198.19.242.71'
  v=apply(c1,probe);denied(v,'overlaps a connected');report['observations']['private_first_public_second']=v
  report['observations']['benchmark_without_public_conflict']=bb;report['observations']['original_mapping_after_reverse_rejection']=reach()
  benchmark_server=prefix+'-benchmark';containers.append(benchmark_server)
  run(['docker','run','-d','--name',benchmark_server,'--network',bb['Name'],'--ip',benchmark['Address'],IMAGE,'python3','-u','-c',program.replace('public-owner','benchmark-private')])
  deadline=time.monotonic()+5
  while True:
   try:
    with socket.create_connection((benchmark['Address'],8080),.2):break
   except ConnectionRefusedError:
    if time.monotonic()>=deadline:raise
    time.sleep(.05)
  with socket.create_connection((benchmark['Address'],8080),3) as s:
   s.settimeout(3);answer=s.recv(64).decode();assert answer=='benchmark-private\n',answer
  report['observations']['benchmark_private_packet']=answer.strip()
  # Retained quarantine identity alone, without a route, must exclude a later private bridge.
  qpublic='198.19.243.71';qt=table(qpublic);tables.append(qt);publics.append(qpublic);qowner=new_owner();controller_hash=hashlib.sha256(('/tmp/'+prefix).encode()).hexdigest()
  helper('nft -f - <<\'EOF\'\ntable ip '+qt+' {\n comment "stackd:'+qowner+'"\n chain identity { comment "'+qpublic+' '+base['Address']+' '+b['Device']+' '+base['Gateway']+'"; }\n chain controller { comment "'+controller_hash+'"; }\n chain quarantine_in { type filter hook prerouting priority -310; policy accept; ip daddr '+qpublic+' drop; }\n}\nEOF')
  qspec=private_spec(243);bridges.append(qspec);v=call(c2,'bridge',Spec=qspec);denied(v,'overlaps native public IPv4');report['observations']['quarantine_witness_exclusion']=v
  # Two actual controller processes race bridge creation against mapping installation.
  race_spec=private_spec(244);bridges.append(race_spec);race_map=copy.deepcopy(base);race_map['Policy']['PublicIPv4']='198.19.244.71';publics.append(race_map['Policy']['PublicIPv4']);tables.append(table(publics[-1]))
  with open('/run/lock/stackd-public-network.lock','rb') as race_lock:
   fcntl.flock(race_lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
   with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as ex:
    f1=ex.submit(call,c1,'bridge',Spec=race_spec);f2=ex.submit(apply,c2,race_map)
    time.sleep(.2);waiting=not f1.done() and not f2.done()
    fcntl.flock(race_lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
    v1=f1.result();v2=f2.result();assert waiting,(v1,v2)
  assert ('error' in v1)!=('error' in v2),(v1,v2)
  denied(v1 if 'error' in v1 else v2,'overlaps');report['observations']['separate_controller_race']={'both_waited_for_host_lock':waiting,'bridge':v1,'mapping':v2}
  # Actual host flock held independently: cancellation must not block or leak ownership.
  with open('/run/lock/stackd-public-network.lock','rb') as lock:
   fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
   started=time.monotonic();v=call(c1,'bridge',Spec=base,TimeoutMillis=150);elapsed=time.monotonic()-started;denied(v,'context deadline exceeded');assert elapsed<2,(elapsed,v)
   v2=call(c2,'apply',Name=owner,Spec=base,Peer=peer,Bridge=b,TimeoutMillis=150);denied(v2,'context deadline exceeded')
   v3=call(c2,'remove',Name=owner,TimeoutMillis=150);denied(v3,'context deadline exceeded')
   fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_UN)
  assert 'error' not in apply(c1,base);assert okay(c2,'bridge',Spec=base)==b
  report['observations']['cancellation_and_lock_release']={'bridge':v,'apply':v2,'remove':v3,'bridge_seconds':elapsed,'mapping_after_release':reach()}
  # A controller in another mount namespace must either share the daemon inode or fail.
  for shared in [False,True]:
   cname=prefix+('-shared-lock' if shared else '-unshared-lock')
   command=['docker','run','--rm','-i','--name',cname,'-v',binary+':/controller:ro','-v','/var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock']
   if shared:command+=['-v','/run/lock:/run/lock:ro']
   command += [IMAGE,'sh','-ec','mkdir -p /run/lock; exec /controller']
   try:
    commands=[{'Op':'bridge','Spec':base,'StateDirectory':'/tmp/'+prefix}]
    if not shared:commands += [{'Op':op,'Name':owner,'Spec':base,'Peer':peer,'Bridge':b,'StateDirectory':'/tmp/'+prefix} for op in ['apply','remove']]
    r=subprocess.run(command,input=''.join(json.dumps(cmd)+'\n' for cmd in commands),text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=45)
    assert r.returncode==0,(r.stdout,r.stderr)
    results=[json.loads(line) for line in r.stdout.splitlines()]
    assert len(results)==len(commands),results
    if shared:assert results[0].get('result')==b,results
    else:
     for v in results:denied(v,'share the daemon-host /run/lock inode')
     assert reach()=='public-owner'
    report['observations']['controller_namespace_shared' if shared else 'controller_namespace_unshared']=results
   finally:
    run(['docker','rm','-f',cname],False)
    report['cleanup'][cname]=run(['docker','inspect',cname],False).returncode!=0
except Exception:
 report['error']=traceback.format_exc()
finally:
 for owner_name in owners:
  if controllers:
   v=call(controllers[0],'remove',Name=owner_name);report['cleanup'][owner_name]='error' not in v
 for name in containers:report['cleanup'][name]=run(['docker','rm','-f',name],False).returncode==0
 for spec in reversed(bridges):
  if controllers:report['cleanup'][spec['NetworkID']]='error' not in call(controllers[0],'release',Spec=spec)
 for c in controllers:c.stdin.close();c.wait(timeout=10)
 native=json.loads(helper('nft -j list tables'));report['cleanup']['native_tables_absent']=not any(x.get('table',{}).get('name') in owners+tables for x in native['nftables'])
 report['cleanup']['routes_absent']=all(json.loads(helper('ip -j route show table main exact '+p+'/32'))==[] for p in publics)
 report['cleanup']['admission_absent']=all(not any(t in helper('nft list chain ip '+chain) for t in tables) for chain in ['filter DOCKER-USER','raw PREROUTING'])
 report['cleanup']['containers_absent']=all(run(['docker','inspect',c],False).returncode!=0 for c in containers)
 report['cleanup']['bridges_absent']=all(run(['docker','network','inspect','stackd-ecs-network-'+hashlib.sha256(s['NetworkID'].encode()).hexdigest()],False).returncode!=0 for s in bridges)
 path='/tmp/stackd-bridge-overlap-'+phase+'.json';open(path,'w').write(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
 if 'error' in report or not all(report['cleanup'].values()):raise SystemExit(1)

limitations: Native proof uses real Docker containers, Linux routes/nftables/flock and real TCP; no native AWS calls, QEMU boot or service SQLite.
Rootless, userns-remapped and non-Linux host rejection paths are explicit but were not runtime exercised.
Separate-controller overlap race observed mapping winner/private bridge rejection; sequential proof also exercised private-first/public-second.
Shared daemon-host /run/lock is required for controller containers; different mount namespaces were exercised with read-only host bind success and unshared inode rejection for bridge/apply/remove.
Existing shared host lock inode was deliberately retained and never unlinked.
markers: compute/network/native.go: remote/Desktop native networking needs a daemon-host lock coordinator; never substitute an unrelated controller-local inode.
compute/network/native_lock_other.go: admission requires a Linux controller sharing the daemon-host lock inode; remote/Desktop unsupported.
